name: detail-card
description: One per-type ACTION detail block: a label/value table whose rows are config, so a theme can resequence or drop them without the page emitting different markup.

type.description: The action type, lowercased with underscores as hyphens. Names the block: info-<type>.

rows.description: Ordered { label, cell } rows. A row with cell:null is markup that is not a label/value pair and is never moved.

reveal.description: Whether mounting un-hides the block. action.html mounts exactly one card per view.
